entry.title: New: dsh-multi-lang-ui
entry.summary: Add six languages (繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Français, Deutsch, Español) to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI language options, with hand-polished per-language translations and automatic fallbacks (Simplified-to-Traditional conversion for zh-TW, English for the others) covering upstream updates and third-party plugins. Exact install spec: github:asd13006/dsh-multi-lang-ui. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
